note: Two Make.com scenarios total (free-plan limit is 2 active scenarios): (1) FB-LINKEDIN-OSTAPDOTCENKO — one webhook, Router splitting unconditionally (no filter — same content set fans out to both) into two branches: Facebook Pages 'Create a Post with Photos' (Page fixed to ostapdotcenko, Photos field Map-toggled ON as a whole and bound directly to {{1.images_ru}} — the full array of every inline image/chart in the article body, not just the cover — Post caption={{1.text_ru}}) and LinkedIn 'Create a User Image Post' (personal profile connection, Image URL={{1.image_en}} via 'Upload by link' — single image only, this LinkedIn module has no array/Map option for Photos unlike Facebook's, Content={{1.text_en}}, capped to 2500 chars in the script — LinkedIn mangles longer posts, was previously 3900 which itself replaced no-limit-at-all after a 4800-char post got rejected outright with a 400). Facebook gets Russian with the full image gallery, LinkedIn gets English with just the cover image — see ostapdotcenko/scripts/post-to-facebook.mjs, which pulls title/excerpt/body/images separately from src/i18n/ru.ts and src/i18n/en.ts for the same slug. Run manually after publishing a new blog article (RU+EN both needed). Gallery support + LinkedIn 2500-char cap added 14.09.2026. (2) FB-POST-AURA-GTT — ONE shared webhook for both Aura and Global Tech Tour Facebook pages, with a Router splitting on the payload's 'project' field ('aura' or 'globaltechtour', lowercase exact match — filters are case-sensitive, this bit us once) into two Facebook Pages 'Create a Post with Photos' branches, each with its Page fixed, Photos->URL={{1.image}}, Post caption={{1.text}}. No 'link' field anywhere in any scenario — the article/site URL is folded into the text itself since these are native photo posts, not link-preview cards. content_mode 'mirrors_blog' (ostapdotcenko only): FB+LinkedIn both reuse that project's own blog article content directly, just in different languages. content_mode 'original' (aura, globaltechtour): the FB post MUST be original content, meaningfully different from that day's blog article and Telegram posts — drafted as JSON ({text, image}) in claude-control/data/fb-queue/<project>/<name>.json, posted via `node claude-control/scripts/post-to-facebook.mjs <project> <name>.json`, which reads this file for the right webhook_url and folds in the project field automatically, then moves the draft to fb-queue/<project>/sent/.
